Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class Languages

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.Languages
public final class Languages extends Object
The built-in language catalogue of the Advanced Text Editor: the immutable list of Language definitions and the extension-based lookup used to pick one when a file is opened. A file with an unknown extension (or no extension at all) falls back to PLAIN, which colourises nothing — the editor never guesses wrong in a damaging way.

Every other entry spells out its keywords, because those languages are external and their word lists are data to the editor. Mandela is the desktop's own language and takes its keywords from the language jar itself (Keywords), so the parser and the editor cannot disagree about what a keyword is: when the grammar gains a word, the colouring follows in the same build.
